messages.content:
Risk: Revealing confidential information
Description: When confidential information is used in training data, fine-tuning data, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing confidential information is a type of data leakage.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output and reveal information that was meant to be secret.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage. [found by 5/10 queries]
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#EmploymentDataExposure: Employment Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of employment information including compensation, performance evaluations, or workplace records that individuals expect to remain confidential. [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#CustomerListDisclosure: Customer List Disclosure — Revealing confidential customer databases, contact information, or client relationship details protected as trade secrets. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Formula Disclosure, Process Disclosure
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Funds/CollectiveInvestmentVehicles/RiskLevel: risk level — None [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind

axes.rationale: This class directly addresses the risk of revealing confidential business information, aligning with the description of revealing confidential information or IP.
This class addresses the exposure of confidential employment information, which falls under the broader concern of revealing confidential data.
